largest_remaining_blockers.description: Mixture of prose order covers and table pages with damaged/split GP identifiers or allocation numbers. 85 raw-only pages carry an unverified order-cover heuristic; they remain in the backlog. Many original scans are rotated, but no unverified district-wide rotation was applied.

All 204 orientations individually verified and repaired. The 130 remaining raw-only pages are visually confirmed ward tables, chiefly with dense compressed text, split GP-name/Roman tokens, damaged numeric allocations, or unread header labels. Rotation alone does not recover these fields. A 3600-pixel/PSM3 diagnostic still failed to recover Maynaguri p2 column labels.

Remaining rows have split/corrupted identity tokens, missing allocation numbers, or unimplemented ZP OCR layouts. Ambiguous GP/PS names withhold category joins. Raw words and previous extraction attempts remain available.

claim: Extraction attempts cover all selected OCR pages; complete field parsing or field accuracy is not claimed.
